# TinyStudio.io

TinyStudio.io is temporarily closed while the next public surface is being built.

Canonical URL: https://tinystudio.io/
Contact: hello@tinystudio.io

## Current Public State

The public website is a cryptic coming-soon page with one email signup form for launch updates.

The site is not currently publishing sprint offers, pricing, claims, public case studies, or automated product access.

## Email Capture

Visitors can leave an email through the public signup form. The form writes to TinyStudio's private launch list through `/api/signups`.

There is no public endpoint for reading collected emails.
